Name: Eemie's Medieval Modern Buildings for Alternative Textures (AT)
Author: lydocia
Description:
[size=3][img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hdr_description.png[/img]

When I first started playing modded Stardew Valley, I found eemiestardew's mods - back then, we were still overwriting .xnb files in the game files, good times - and I fell in [i]love[/i] with these medieval buildings. I used them in all my games, and then when the [b]Customise Exterior [/b]mod came out, I was so happy I could cry. It has since been discontinued and, luckily, been replaced by [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url][/b].

I rearranged Eemie's buildings into the AT folder structure and created the .json files to go with it, and I'm here sharing that with you because you all [i]need[/i] this gorgeousness in your game, seriously. Thank me later. You're welcome.

I edited one of the tower assets and added the four obelisks (Desert, Earth, Island and Water).

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Xle500C.png[/img]

[img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hr.png[/img]  
[img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hdr_install.png[/img]
[/size][list=1]
[size=3]
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿
3. Download the .zip file(s) and extract into your /Mods folder

There is an optional file that contains my four obelisks.
If you want them, install it as described above.[/size][/list][list=1]
[/list][list=1]
[size=3]
[/size][/list][size=3][img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hr.png[/img]
[img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hdr_use.png[/img]

Recolour your buildings using the Paint Bucket from the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] mod.

This mod is just a content pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url], if the mod isn't properly working, please check with them first!


 [img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hr.png[/img]
[img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hdr_bugreports.png[/img]

If you have any [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url][b]-[/b]specific issues, please direct them to the devs on their respective mod page.﻿

Please report any other issues you may find in the 'Bugs' tab (as I might miss them in the general posts tab).

[img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hr.png[/img] [img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hdr_credits.png[/img]

The graphics in this mod were originally made by [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/index.php?/user/34984615-eemiestardew/]eemiestardew[/url].
All credit for the original artwork goes to Eemie. 
Edits by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/11157158]lydocia[/url].
[i]The original (hidden) mod on Nexus can be found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/682]here[/url]﻿.
The Content Patcher version for SDV 1.4 can be found [url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/636391-eemies-medieval-modern-buildings]here[/url]﻿.

Thank you for putting your gorgeous work into the Stardew community, Eemie! ♥

[/i]I asked and received permission to repack her assets on the 18th of May, 2022.
